Thirty-one class meetings run from **Tuesday, August 25** through **Thursday,
December 10, 2026**. Chapter numbers refer to Prince, *Understanding Deep
Learning* (MIT Press, 2024).

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Read the assigned chapter **before** the first meeting of the week. Lecture time
is spent on the parts that are hard to get from reading alone: derivations,
failure modes, and code.

Weekly assignments are posted in Blackboard with their own due dates; the **Due**
column below carries only the exam and project milestones.
:::

## Meeting-by-Meeting Detail

### Part I — Foundations

| Date | Session | Topic |
|:-------------|:--:|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| Tue, Aug 25 | 1 | Course overview; what deep learning is and is not |
| Thu, Aug 27 | 2 | Supervised learning: models, parameters, training |
| Tue, Sep 1 | 3 | Linear algebra and calculus you actually need |
| Thu, Sep 3 | 4 | Probability refresher; PyTorch tensors and autograd |
| Tue, Sep 8 | 5 | Shallow networks: one hidden layer, ReLU, linear regions |
| Thu, Sep 10 | 6 | Universal approximation; shallow networks in PyTorch |
| Tue, Sep 15 | 7 | Composing networks; matrix notation for deep models |
| Thu, Sep 17 | 8 | Depth vs. width; counting linear regions |

: {tbl-colwidths="[22,8,70]"}

### Part II — Training Neural Networks

| Date | Session | Topic |
|:-------------|:--:|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| Tue, Sep 22 | 9 | Maximum likelihood; recipe for constructing losses |
| Thu, Sep 24 | 10 | Regression, binary and multiclass classification losses |
| Tue, Sep 29 | 11 | Gradient descent; loss surfaces and local minima |
| Thu, Oct 1 | 12 | Stochastic gradient descent, momentum, Adam |
| Tue, Oct 6 | 13 | Backpropagation derived and implemented from scratch |
| Thu, Oct 8 | 14 | Vanishing/exploding gradients; He and Glorot initialization |
| Tue, Oct 13 | 15 | Training, validation, and test error; the bias–variance trade-off |
| Thu, Oct 15 | 16 | Double descent; hyperparameter search; midterm review |
| Tue, Oct 20 | 17 | Explicit and implicit regularization; dropout, early stopping |

: {tbl-colwidths="[22,8,70]"}
